prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, specialty (hospital system, clinic, med device, pharma, behavioral health, etc.), and whether you need digital performance, creative branding, PR, or a full-service partner. Instead of one name, here’s a quick, practical way to find the best fit and some next steps I can help with.

What to prioritize when choosing a healthcare marketing agency
- Healthcare experience and compliance: HIPAA, patient privacy, and (if applicable) FDA/pharma rules. Ask for case studies in healthcare.
- Relevant vertical experience: hospitals vs. outpatient clinics vs. med device vs. behavioral health — results transfer differently.
- Measurable outcomes: patient acquisition cost, ROI on ad spend, conversions, retention.
- Full-stack capabilities you need: SEO/content, paid search, paid social, programmatic, CRM/email automation, telehealth integration, analytics.
- Creative + brand + patient experience: healthcare requires empathy and trust-building.
- Reporting and data access: dashboards, regular reporting cadence, attribution modeling.
- References and proof: portfolio, client references, before/after metrics.
- Fit and capacity: team size, responsiveness, cultural fit, and whether they’ll dedicate senior staff to your account.

Where to find and compare agencies
- Clutch.co, DesignRush, UpCity — filter by “healthcare” + “St. Louis.”
- LinkedIn searches for agencies in St. Louis with healthcare case studies.
- St. Louis Business Journal / local industry awards lists.
- Ask peers in local healthcare networks / associations (HIMSS St. Louis, local hospital marketing groups).

Key questions to ask prospects
- Which healthcare clients have you worked with and what were the results? Can you share specific KPIs?
- How do you handle HIPAA/compliance and PHI in campaigns?
- What’s your process for patient acquisition and for reducing churn?
- What tools/platforms do you use (analytics, CRM, ad platforms)?
- Who will be on our account and what are their backgrounds?
- Typical timeline and budget ranges for projects similar to ours?
- Can you provide references?

If you want, I can:
- Build a short list of St. Louis agencies that specialize in healthcare (I’ll search current directories and reviews).
- Draft an RFP or a standard vetting questionnaire you can send to agencies.
- Help evaluate proposals or compare two or three agencies if you have names.

Tell me more about your organization (type of healthcare, goals, budget range, and whether you want local-only or national reach) and I’ll create a tailored short list and evaluation plan.
